content.short: Merchant Moe is Mantle's primary DEX and liquidity hub featuring the advanced Liquidity Book protocol and rewards.
content.description: Merchant Moe is the cornerstone decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively for the Mantle Network. Developed by the expert team behind Trader Joe (LFJ), the platform brings advanced trading technology to Mantle through its unique "Liquidity Book" protocol. This design allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital with extreme precision, significantly increasing fee capture and capital efficiency compared to traditional AMM models. Merchant Moe serves as the central venue for trading ecosystem tokens and bootstrapping new projects with MOE rewards.
content.meta: Merchant Moe is the leading AMM DEX and liquidity hub on Mantle, featuring concentrated liquidity. Explore Merchant Moe on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
